Margins 0.4.6 makes Workspace setup purpose-first and refreshes the public
open-core source around that workflow.

- The setup guide now begins by understanding one knowledge practice, explains
  what Margins believes the folders and notes mean, and invites corrections in
  plain language before presenting configuration.
- Supported corrections are compiled into a fresh, deterministic settings
  plan. Margins applies only the final plan the user reviewed, unchanged, and
  proves the resulting setup with a live local recall result.
- Guided onboarding and connected-note distillation now keep their roles clear:
  setup establishes a trustworthy Workspace, while distillation starts from the
  latest session or user-supplied evidence and reviews the note before writing.
- The public repository is refreshed with the current buildable Rust workspace,
  agent skills, Workspace and Source contracts, integration connectors, and
  explicit open-core composition boundaries.
- Official CLI capture, hosted recovery, source refresh, and recall integration
  include the reliability work completed since 0.4.4.

Official binaries include the complete recording and recall composition. The
public open-core source remains available for audit and extension; recordings,
transcripts, and Workspace contents remain under the user's control.
